# Zilog Z8000

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from `crates/isa/src/z8000.rs`. Edits here are overwritten; change the spec instead. -->

182 instructions, words big-endian. Generated from [`crates/isa/src/z8000.rs`](https://github.com/asm198x/asm198x/blob/main/crates/isa/src/z8000.rs).

The Z8000 is specified family by family, because the families genuinely differ: a block move carries a shape and a control nibble, an I/O instruction carries a direction, a shift carries whether its count is a following word. The tables below keep that structure, and each shows the columns its family actually has.

Sizes are the operand widths a mnemonic assembles at. `Rn` is a word register, `@Rn` an indirect one, `addr` a direct address and `addr(Rn)` an indexed one.

## Arithmetic, logic and load

The dyadic family: a destination register and a source in any of the addressing modes listed.

| Mnemonic | Base | Size | Source modes | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ADD | `01` | word | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Add |
| ADDB | `00` | byte | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Add byte |
| SUB | `03` | word | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Subtract |
| SUBB | `02` | byte | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Subtract byte |
| OR | `05` | word | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Or |
| ORB | `04` | byte | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Or byte |
| AND | `07` | word | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | And |
| ANDB | `06` | byte | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | And byte |
| XOR | `09` | word | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Exclusive or |
| XORB | `08` | byte | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Exclusive or byte |
| CP | `0B` | word | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Compare |
| CPB | `0A` | byte | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Compare byte |
| LD | `21` | word | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Load |
| LDB | `20` | byte | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Load byte |
| ADC | `35` | word | Rn | Add with carry |
| ADCB | `34` | byte | Rn | Add with carry byte |
| SBC | `37` | word | Rn | Subtract with carry |
| SBCB | `36` | byte | Rn | Subtract with carry byte |
| CPL | `10` | long | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Compare long |
| SUBL | `12` | long | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Subtract long |
| LDL | `14` | long | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Load long |
| ADDL | `16` | long | #n, @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Add long |
| EX | `2D` | word | @Rn, addr, addr(Rn), Rn | Exchange |

## Program control

| Mnemonic | Base | Shape | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| JP | `001E` | A memory operand, with a condition code in the low nibble | Jump |
| CALL | `001F` | A memory operand, with a condition code in the low nibble | Call |
| JR | `00E0` | A condition code, then a word-scaled signed 8-bit PC offset | Jump relative |
| RET | `9E00` | A condition code only | Return |
| DJNZ | `00F0` | A register, then a 7-bit backward word offset | Decrement and jump if not zero |
| DBJNZ | `00F0` | A register, then a 7-bit backward word offset | Decrement byte and jump if not zero |
| CALR | `00D0` | A 12-bit backward word offset | Call relative |
